spec.title: Setup: run RoaringBitmap #914's landed FastAggregation tests at both revisions
spec.description: Setup for case M03 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/worktrees (M03-RoaringBitmap-fix = b4b0ba16e50d40688753a3cf057a47804773e233, M03-RoaringBitmap-parent = 49e120dad9c21349c44f3aa3edfc9a6601e7a7b0), runs the upstream Gradle build (Gradle 9.6.1 distribution checked against services.gradle.org, JDK 21.0.13, the cache's GRADLE_USER_HOME, already resolved and compiled inline by the setup) for org.roaringbitmap.TestFastAggregation and org.roaringbitmap.buffer.TestFastAggregation: on the fix online then offline, on the parent its own copies offline, then the fix's two test files transplanted onto the parent (the new subtype-array tests are expected to fail with ArrayStoreException; the build has failFast=true, so the run stops at the first failure). The build's test JVM has a fixed 2 GB heap, which is why this is a job. JUnit summaries to .../logs, worktrees restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: the fix's landed tests pass online and offline, the parent's own pass, the transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED with at least one failure

steps.name: M03 fix: landed TestFastAggregation (heap and buffer), online
